title: The octothorpe
slide_intent: Make a mark’s construction visible so designers can recognize its component shapes at different sizes and in other graphics.
strategic_value: Slack can extend two simple shapes from the symbol into a broader visual vocabulary while preserving a recognizable family resemblance.
demonstration: The four-color symbol is shown alone and again on a 19-by-19 grid. The text identifies a speech bubble and a lozenge as its two basic shapes.
practical_value: Compare the unobstructed symbol with the grid when identifying which shapes and proportions belong to its construction.
